description: Enterprise Express.js API design: modular routing, secure middleware chaining with Helmet and CORS, centralized async error-handling middleware, Zod request validation, and graceful shutdown.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Enterprise Express.js Architecture & Security

Design robust, resilient, and secure Node.js RESTful microservices using Express.js.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Every endpoint payload must be validated at the boundary using strict `Zod` schemas.
- Register `helmet()` and restrictive `cors()` middleware before any route handlers.
- Handle all async controller errors via a single centralized error-handling middleware (`(err, req, res, next)`).
- Intercept `SIGTERM` and `SIGINT` to gracefully drain database connections before exiting.
